verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a payroll and business-management platform like Gusto, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents an MCP server, a CLI, an OpenAPI spec, webhooks and SDKs, but none of it mentions batch or bulk actions across many items at once. Per-item CLI commands and APIs are developer building blocks, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
